subject: Your Redwood trial — schedule a quick technical check
messages:
From: no-reply@redwood.ai
To: Michael O'Rourke <michael@wavebook.ai>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-05-21T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — pick a 20-minute technical check-in

Hi Michael,

Thanks for signing up for a Redwood trial — we’re excited to see what you build. If you’d like a short technical walkthrough to accelerate integration (20 minutes), you can pick a time with one of our engineers here: https://meet.redwood.ai/quick/7f4c

What we cover in 20 minutes:
- Quick review of your integration goals
- Environment & token setup tips
- One short run of your sample workload (latency/cost expectations)

If you book a slot, one of our engineers will reach out with a quick checklist so we can use the time efficiently. If you prefer, I’ve cc'd a sales engineer (jonas.weber@redwood.ai) who can also surface relevant docs.

— The Redwood onboarding team
(no-reply@redwood.ai)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Michael O'Rourke <michael@wavebook.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-05-21T17:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Welcome to Redwood — pick a 20-minute technical check-in

Hi Michael —

Thanks for signing up and for the quick intro. I’m Jonas (Senior Sales Engineer) — happy to run the 20-minute session and focus on whatever matters most to you (throughput, latency, cost, or private deployment concerns).

If it helps, here are three short windows I have next week (all PT):
- Tue 2025-05-27 11:00–11:20
- Wed 2025-05-28 09:30–09:50
- Thu 2025-05-29 14:00–14:20

Or self-book a slot on my direct link: https://meet.redwood.ai/j/jonas-weber/20min

I attached a one-page trial quickstart that summarizes the steps we’ll run through. If you have a short prompt or a sample request you want me to run during the call, paste it into your reply and I’ll queue it up.

Best,

Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134
